request.summary: Update the three live/user-facing !link references (config description, NOT_LINKED panel message, README dev-setup instructions) to reference the bot's new /link-plugin slash command instead of the retired !link prefix command.
request.raw_requirements:
Fix stale "!link" references in the RuneLite plugin - the bot's linking command changed from the legacy !link prefix command to a /link-plugin slash command (which now also requires the RSN as a required option and gates on WOM clan + Discord membership - see catabot/src/commands/link-plugin/index.ts). Four references to the old !link command were found in this repo:

1. src/main/java/com/catastrophic/events/CatastrophicEventsConfig.java:14 - the "Plugin token" config item's description text, shown in RuneLite's config UI.
2. src/main/java/com/catastrophic/events/ui/CatastrophicEventsPanel.java:152 - the NOT_LINKED state message shown directly in the plugin's side panel to any user who hasn't linked yet - this is the most user-visible of the four.
3. README.md:130 - the "Running it locally" dev setup instructions.
4. poc-runelite-plugin.md:8 - the original scope/design doc, already flagged as generally stale in concerns.json (KI-004, "should not be trusted for endpoint paths"). Decision made during intake: leave this one alone - it's explicitly historical/frozen design documentation and KI-004 already warns not to trust it.

Update the three live/user-facing references to reference /link-plugin instead of !link, accurately reflecting that it's now a slash command with an RSN option.

plan.approach: Straightforward text-only fix: update the three live user-facing strings to reference /link-plugin (a slash command with a required rsn option) instead of the retired !link prefix command, then compile to confirm nothing else broke. poc-runelite-plugin.md is left alone per the intake decision.
steps: Step 1 - src/main/java/com/catastrophic/events/CatastrophicEventsConfig.java:14 - change the "Plugin token" description from "Paste the token DM'd to you by the !link command in Discord." to "Paste the token DM'd to you by the /link-plugin command in Discord."

Step 2 - src/main/java/com/catastrophic/events/ui/CatastrophicEventsPanel.java:152 - change the NOT_LINKED message from "Run !link in Discord, then paste the token it DMs you here via Event Setup below." to "Run /link-plugin in Discord (with your RSN), then paste the token it DMs you here via Event Setup below."
Step 3 - README.md:130 - change `!link <rsn>` to `/link-plugin <rsn>`, adjusting surrounding wording since it's now a slash command, not a typed prefix command.
Step 4 - Manual QA: ./gradlew compileJava to confirm it compiles clean.

verification.notes: Definition of done confirmed (all 4 plan steps complete, conventions followed, no unit tests since no test framework exists in this repo - TD-001, no staging branch in use here). Concerns check: none - pure string change. Dev UAT: config description confirmed live via ./gradlew run across two separate sessions (developer was already linked both times, so the NOT_LINKED panel message itself wasn't directly observed live, but it's the same one-line string-swap pattern in the same code path, verified correct in source and compiles clean). Developer accepted this reasoning rather than requiring a token-clear just to observe it.
